model.title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 13355 North Lon Adams Road in Marana, Arizona, as the Mayor Ed Honea Memorial Post Office.
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. Juan Ciscomani (R-AZ)

summary.text: The bill would designate a U.S. Postal Service facility in Marana, Arizona, as the Mayor Ed Honea Memorial Post Office, honoring the former mayor.
